-80.15460,26.35120.name: Palm Beach Fertility Center
-80.15460,26.35120.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

4.47105,50.88862.name: Dr. Mine Duran
4.47105,50.88862.desc: A clinic mapped in OpenStreetMap as offering fertility treatment. OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. That is the reverse of the national registers alongside it, which are close to complete for one country and silent everywhere else. This layer is a cross-check and a source of leads, not a count.

-78.90181,35.99665.name: BD Technologies and Innovation
-78.90181,35.99665.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of Becton, Dickinson & Company. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-57.55081,-38.00277.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: http://www.crecerreproduccion.com.ar/web/. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.

-73.95334,40.78983.name: Mount Sinai School of Medicine
-73.95334,40.78983.state: 1 Gustave L. Levy Pl, New York, NY 10029, United States, United States
-73.95334,40.78983.desc: A BSL3+ laboratory, operational. Run by Mount Sinai School of Medicine. It is categorised as a university laboratory, working on human health. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.
